page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a narrow column of small notes in the right margin (partly faded). Running head at top centre; page number top right.

main_text.p: Rundon, Sufurrabunt] Sufurrare, muffitare, Sax. punian: Belg. Runen, Roener, nobis hodie to rounde, & rounde, de quo plura per Spelman.noftr. in Wormii Literatura Runica, cap. 1.
main_text.head: S.
main_text.p: Saca, Rem] Sax. Caufa, rac & race: unde noftrum fake, ut Dei intuitu, vulgo dicimus, fo; Gods fake. Proprie tamen Res, Saxon. Zinz, quod nobis manfit.

Saletbu, Tabernaculo: & Selt-thon, Tabernacula, & Seltha, Tabernaculum. Nos falett, paulo alio sensu] Hoc Sax. zerele. Belgis fale, pro Aula, Atrium: olim autem pro universa domo sumptum fuit; De quo in De variis Glossematis, Cl. Vossius, in voce Sala.
Sammung, Synagoga. Unde Verfaemen, & fammongun, Cleros, causa collectionis] Synagoga Sax. zeromnun-za, ab eorum zeromnian fluens, quod congregare notat.
Scale, Servus. Unde Maris-scalcus, qui equis curator] Servus Sax. zcealc; Hac

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are faded and largely illegible (only a fragmentary mark such as "9.4" is visible near the top); not transcribed. Several Old English/Saxon words are uncertain and may contain transcription errors; the black letter glosses are approximated.
